group_manifest.proof_strategy: First prove the five suffixed helpers in the group-local case_lib using direct list/dllseg induction and no forbidden lemma. Prove entail_wit_1 by splitting anchor into sentinel/member and applying open or first-member split. Prove return_wit_1/2/3/4 by selecting the branch matching the recorded guard, deriving empty/nonempty suffix value, joining when needed, and closing xizi_dll. Prove both derived specs by choosing the same abstract list and constructing the wand by direct adjunction; for member dispatch first derive node<>head from head-not-in.

candidate_helper_declarations.purpose: reduce the member dispatch result at the earliest list occurrence
expose the prefix, queried-node links, suffix, and representation guards from xizi_dll membership
reclose prefix, queried-node links, and suffix into the full segment
show a member query is distinct from the sentinel before unfolding dispatch

group_entry.proof_strategy: First prove the five suffixed helpers in the group-local case_lib using direct list/dllseg induction and no forbidden lemma. Prove entail_wit_1 by splitting anchor into sentinel/member and applying open or first-member split. Prove return_wit_1/2/3/4 by selecting the branch matching the recorded guard, deriving empty/nonempty suffix value, joining when needed, and closing xizi_dll. Prove both derived specs by choosing the same abstract list and constructing the wand by direct adjunction; for member dispatch first derive node<>head from head-not-in.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: The concrete list ownership never changes. The proof only changes its view: whole circular list, sentinel-open view, or prefix/query/suffix view. The pure result follows from whether the selected link points to the sentinel or to the first element of a nonempty suffix. The derived specs specialize the unified dispatch definition to node=head or node<>head.
group_entry.grouping_reason: All seven witnesses are within the maximum group size, share one DLL structural helper family, and should be proved sequentially by one worker so the suffixed helper declarations are proved once. Splitting derived specs into a second group would duplicate the head-not-in/dispatch reasoning without a true dependency boundary.
